lines.en: I have cried twice in my life.
Once when I was seven and I was hit by a school bus.
And then again when I heard that little Sebastian had passed.
As today we light a fire that will burn on for eternity.
Okay, deep breath. I think we got through it.
Thank God. Hey, Jerry, you put propane in the eternal flame, right?
No, they were out. So I just got a big thing of lighter fluid.
It's kind of the same thing.
